comment: Voiced radio lines. 'key' is the localization key the ticker shows as the subtitle (en and vi); 'speak' is the English the voice reads (dates spelled for speech). Source text: docs/design/text/radio-letters.md.

lines.speak: Weather tonight. Clear skies over the Sea of Tranquility, as always.
March seventeenth, twenty forty-seven. Lumen Station, this is Houston relay. All four crew landed safely. Program review postponed. Stand by.
April second, twenty forty-seven. Lumen Station, this is Houston relay. A return window is under study. Keep station systems on standby.
May eleventh, twenty forty-seven. Lumen Station, this is Houston relay. Return window cancelled. Program review continues.
September twenty-ninth, twenty forty-seven. Lumen Station, this is Houston relay. Program closed. This channel will no longer be monitored. Thank you, Lumen.
Oh seven, it's Ro. They say nobody's listening up there. I'm sending this anyway. Ro. The ninth of June, twenty forty-eight.
Inez took a desk job. She still walks round the block every morning, to check Earth is still there. Ro. The fourteenth of July, twenty forty-nine.
Theo says the basil on my windowsill isn't as good as yours was. Don't tell him I agree. Ro. The second of August, twenty fifty-one.
Kenji fixed my kettle with a paperclip, and a long speech about tolerances. He says hello to the duck. Ro. The thirtieth of October, twenty fifty-four.
If that old dish ever wakes up, I'll be listening on the station's frequency. You know how to find me. Three short, one long. Ro. The second of June, twenty fifty-nine.
It's been twenty years. I still play the long drive tape on Sundays. Ro. The thirteenth of March, twenty sixty-seven.
I heard you, oh seven. I'm still here.
Told the others. Theo cried, then blamed hay fever.
Inez went out at midnight to look at the Moon. She says it's still there.
Kenji asked if you still have the odd wheel. I told him all six match now, and he had to sit down.
Played your song on my show tonight. Audience: two neighbours, and a very old cat. Best audience since you.
I told Theo about the dome. He's been unbearable all week.
Weather tonight: rain over Lagos. It's always clear where you are, isn't it?
Inez's daughter wants to be an astronaut. Inez is pretending to be worried.
The four of us wrote to the agency together. Don't hold your breath. You don't breathe anyway.
Kenji's grandson won a rubber duck at the fair. Kenji says it's a sign.
Goodnight, oh seven. Keep the radio on. We'll keep ours on too.
